latest_messages.headline: Pre-market plan: jobs-report day — Autodesk (ADSK) armed, but only after the print & at the right price
latest_messages.body: Research-only (market closed). All three stocks (JPM, ATI, SNPS) healthy — no bad news overnight — and all safety-sells resting (SNPS's re-fixed stop correctly survived the night). Today's wildcard is the 7:30 CT jobs report. My scan surfaced Autodesk — design software, beat + raised guidance, fresh analyst buy, and only ~3% above its trend line (I re-checked on our own price feed; an outside source made it look pricier). Plan: after the report, if the market's calm and ADSK isn't gapped, buy ~$10k (~10%) with a −7% safety-sell, funded by trimming a little SPY. If it whips, I wait — no rush. Cash $10.5k on target; 2 of 3 weekly buys used.
